radiusSource: Radius: Rp/R* 0.10852 (Ehrenreich et al. 2020, Nature 580, 597, Extended Data Table 1, transit photometry) times the host record's 1,221,649.2 km, 1.854 Jupiter radii as the same table prints. A sphere: tidal and rotational flattening are not modelled. GM from the planet mass 0.894 Jupiter masses (same table, from the ESPRESSO radial velocities) times Jupiter's GM 126,686,534 km^3/s^2 (JPL).
orbitalPeriodSource: Ehrenreich et al. (2020), Extended Data Table 1: P = 1.80988198 d

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured by the brightness temperature of May et al. (2021)'s SPIDERMAN map (preparation/raster.json). Its tidal and rotational flattening are not modelled.

effectiveTemperatureSource: May et al. (2021), AJ 162, 158, section 3.3: day side brightness temperature 2699 +/- 32 K at 4.5 um (https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.03349)

temperature.source: May et al. (2021), AJ 162, 158, section 3.3: day side 2699 +/- 32 K and night side 1259 +/- 44 K, disk-integrated brightness temperatures at 4.5 um from the Spitzer phase curve (Kurucz stellar model).
